web_account_nosskey_confirm_text: Protects your private key by encrypting it with the passkey (biometric) PRF (WebAuthn PRF). Back up your nsec before enabling this.
web_channel_create_failed: Couldn’t create it. Check your login and signing, then try again.
web_channel_no_base: Couldn’t fetch the latest thread data, so nothing was saved. Check your connection and try again
web_channel_save_failed: Couldn’t save. Check your login and signing, then try again.
web_channel_stale: The thread was updated on another device. Reopen it before editing
web_columnform_relay_add: Add a relay to publish to
web_columnform_relay_url: URL of the relay to publish to
web_compose_thread_partial: Sent up to post %1$d. The rest were kept in drafts as a new thread
web_data_purge_text: Deletes all saved events, profiles, pending posts, and link cards, then reloads and refetches from relays. Decrypted DMs are also cleared. With NIP-07 / NIP-46 you’ll be asked to approve again the next time you open the app. Your keys, relays, and column settings are kept. This can’t be undone.
web_deck_unsupported_column: This type of column isn’t available on the web yet
web_display_datasaver_desc: While on, images load smaller and at lower quality to save data. Reloading or changing your browser’s data saver setting returns it to the browser’s setting.
web_dm_banner_no_nip44: This extension doesn’t support NIP-44, so NIP-17 DMs can’t be read (only NIP-04 DMs are shown)
web_dm_banner_paused: Decryption paused (the signing request was rejected or got no response)
web_dm_cannot_send: You can’t send DMs with this login method
web_dm_no_nip04: This extension doesn’t support NIP-04, so this message can’t be sent
web_dm_no_nip44: This extension doesn’t support NIP-44, so this message can’t be sent
web_dmrelays_no_base: Couldn’t fetch the latest DM relays, so nothing was published. Check your connection and try again
web_dmrelays_stale: The DM relays were updated elsewhere, so nothing was published. The latest list is shown — review it and try again
web_emoji_copy_failed: Couldn’t copy. The URL is selected, so copy it manually
web_emoji_desc: Make a 128×128 emoji image from text. You can register the URL as a custom emoji as is
web_emoji_error_font_unavailable: Couldn’t load the font. Please try again later
web_emoji_error_invalid_color: Enter the text color in hex (e.g. ff0000)
web_emoji_error_invalid_stroke: Enter the outline color in hex (e.g. ffffff)
web_emoji_error_invalid_text: The text contains control characters that can’t be used
web_emoji_error_network: Couldn’t fetch the image. Check your connection
web_emoji_error_unknown: Couldn’t make the image. Please try again later
web_emoji_error_unsupported_char: “%1$s” can’t be drawn with this font
web_emoji_limit: Up to 4 lines, 10 characters per line
web_emoji_login_hint: Log in to add it to your emoji list.
web_emoji_no_base: Couldn’t fetch the latest emoji list, so nothing was published. Check your connection and try again
web_emoji_stale: The emoji list was updated elsewhere, so nothing was published. The latest list is shown — review it and edit again
web_follow_no_list: Couldn’t fetch your follow list. Check your connection and try again
web_hashtags_no_base: Couldn’t fetch the latest pins, so nothing was saved. Check your connection and try again
web_hashtags_stale: The pins were updated elsewhere, so nothing was saved. The latest list is shown — review it and edit again
web_kansai_desc: Shows the UI text in Kansai dialect. A display-only gimmick on this device; your actual posts do not change.
web_kansai_ja_only: Available only when the UI language is Japanese
web_log_chat_channels_failed: Failed to fetch the channel list
web_log_db_deletion_attach_failed: Failed to subscribe to deletion records
web_log_db_evict_failed: Failed to clean up at startup
web_log_db_open_failed: Can’t open the database; running in memory only
web_log_db_quota: Storage quota exceeded; dropping the data
web_log_db_recreate_failed: Still can’t open it after recreating; running in memory only
web_log_db_save_deletion_failed: Failed to save the deletion record
web_log_delete_request_failed: Failed to send the deletion request
web_log_publish_attempts_failed: Failed to save the attempt count
web_log_publish_delete_failed: Failed to delete the unsent post
web_log_publish_save_failed: Failed to save the unsent post
web_login_backup_copied: Copied. Keep it in a safe place.
web_login_backup_copy_failed: Couldn’t copy. Select the private key shown and write it down.
web_login_backup_warn1: Back it up now. It won’t be shown again once you close this screen.
web_login_backup_warn2: Your private key (nsec) is the only way to log in to this account again. Anyone who has it can fully control your account, so never show or send it to anyone.
web_login_err_bunker_uri: Paste a connection string in the bunker://… format that includes a wss:// relay
web_login_err_connect_timeout: It wasn’t approved within 3 minutes. Show the QR code again
web_login_err_denied: Couldn’t log in. The extension may not have allowed it.
web_login_err_invalid_key: Failed to import nsec: it couldn’t be read as a private key
web_login_err_missing: Extension not found (timed out). Enable the extension, then reload.
web_login_err_nip46_timeout: No response from the signer app. Approve in the app, then try again
web_login_err_unavailable: This browser can’t store the connection info. Log in with an extension (NIP-07).
web_login_help_install: Install one of the following, then reload this page.
web_login_lead: Choose how to log in. We never generate a private key for you on our own. If you don’t have an account, you can create a new key with “Generate new” below.
web_login_new_key_confirm_text: Creates a new private key in this browser, then encrypts and stores it. Your private key (nsec) is shown only once, right after it’s generated. The web version can’t show or export it later, so if you don’t back it up, you’ll never be able to log in to this account again after clearing browser data or leaving it unused for a long time. For an account you’ll keep using, we recommend using an extension (NIP-07).
web_login_nip07_waiting: Waiting for the extension to respond…
web_login_nip46_desc: Connect to a signer app (such as Amber) or nsec.app. Your private key stays in the signer app and is never stored in this browser.
web_login_nip46_qr_hint: Scan the QR code with a signer app (such as Amber), or open the link below if this device has one, then approve the connection.
web_login_nip46_qr_label: QR code for connecting a signer app
web_login_nip46_show_qr: Show a connection QR code (Amber, etc.)
web_login_nsec_warn1: Anyone who knows your private key (nsec) can fully control your account. Log in with an extension (NIP-07) whenever possible.
web_login_nsec_warn2: The imported private key is encrypted and stored only in this browser. The web version can’t show or export it.
web_login_unavailable: This browser can’t store a private key safely. Log in with an extension (NIP-07).
web_logout_text_local: Removes your login info from this device. Your private key (nsec) is erased from this browser, and the web version can’t export it, so it can’t be recovered unless you’ve saved it elsewhere.
web_logout_text_nip07: Removes your login info from this device. Your private key stays in the extension.
web_logout_text_nip46: Removes your login info (the connection to your signer app) from this device. Your private key stays in the signer app.
web_mute_no_base: Couldn’t fetch the latest mute list, so nothing was changed. Check your connection and try again
web_mute_no_cipher: This signing method doesn’t support encryption, so you can’t mute privately (we won’t add it publicly)
web_mute_stale: The mute list was updated elsewhere, so nothing was changed. The latest list is shown — review it and try again
web_nip46_auth_text: Approve on the page that opens and the process will continue. (Connected to: %1$s)
web_nip46_auth_title: Approval needed in your signer app
web_nip46_timeout: No response from the signer app. Open the app, then try again
web_notfound_text: There’s no page for this URL
web_own_list_no_base: Couldn’t fetch the latest data, so nothing was changed. Check your connection and try again
web_picker_make_save: Also save to my emoji list
web_picker_make_save_duplicate: An emoji with this shortcode is already in your list, so it wasn’t saved
web_picker_make_shortcode_hint: Leave empty to name it automatically
web_picker_make_shortcode_invalid: Shortcodes can only use letters, numbers, _ and -
web_profile_edit_no_base: Couldn’t fetch your latest profile from relays. Check your connection
web_profile_edit_stale: Your profile was updated on another device. Reopen it before editing
web_profile_unmute_text: This user’s posts will appear in your timeline again.
web_relays_no_base: Couldn’t fetch the latest relay list, so nothing was published. Check your connection and try again
web_relays_publish_text: Signs your current Read / Write settings as kind:10002 and sends it to your Write relays and indexers. This is published to the network.
web_relays_stale: The relay list was updated elsewhere, so nothing was published. The latest list is shown — review it and edit again
web_settings_account_method_local: Private key (nsec) stored in this browser
web_settings_cache_desc: Clears all caches stored on this device (timeline history, profiles, pending posts, link cards), then reloads and refetches from relays. Decrypted DMs are also cleared. With NIP-07 / NIP-46 you’ll be asked to approve again the next time you open the app. Your keys, relays, and column settings are kept.
web_settings_dmrelay_url_label: URL of the DM relay to add
web_settings_emoji_desc: Your custom emoji list (NIP-51). It appears in the reaction picker and can be used in posts as :shortcode:. Emoji from emoji sets you’ve subscribed to are managed separately and don’t appear here.
web_settings_emoji_input_invalid: Shortcodes allow only letters, numbers, _ and -; image URLs must start with https://
web_settings_hashtags_desc: Pinned tags (NIP-51 kind:30015) are always shown as chips in the compose screen and when creating a hashtag column, and sync across devices. Tags you’ve used are remembered on this device and suggested when you type #.
web_settings_media_compress_desc: When “Low / Medium” is selected, posted images are resized to the long-edge limit below (px) and re-encoded (WebP, or JPEG if that fails). “High” doesn’t shrink them, but re-encodes at the same quality to strip EXIF data such as location. Defaults: Low = %1$dpx, Medium = %2$dpx, quality = %3$d%% (range: long edge %4$d–%5$d / quality %6$d–%7$d).
web_settings_media_compress_reset_label: Reset image upload compression to defaults
web_settings_media_default_order: While none is selected, they’re tried in this order: %1$s.
web_settings_media_desc: When you attach images or videos to a post, they’re uploaded to the selected server.
web_settings_media_url_invalid: Enter a server URL starting with https://
web_settings_nostr_link_desc: Lets this app open nostr: links (npub / nprofile / note / nevent / naddr) from other sites.
web_settings_nostr_link_toggle: Open nostr: links in this app
web_settings_reaction_desc: Choose the shape of the reaction button on each post. Tapping it sends this reaction (you can still pick another emoji from the emoji picker).
web_settings_relay_url_invalid: Enter a relay URL starting with wss://
web_settings_relays_desc: Read = Inbox (used to subscribe and fetch) / Write = Outbox (where your posts are sent). Adding, removing, and toggling take effect on connections right away. “Save” publishes the current list as kind:10002.
web_settings_relays_url_label: URL of the relay to add
web_shortcuts_hint: Press Esc or tap the screen to close
web_signer_no_cipher: The extension doesn’t support this encryption method
web_status_empty: No one you follow has a status right now
web_status_empty_music: No one you follow is playing anything right now
web_status_login_needed: Log in to see statuses from people you follow
web_sync_load_unreachable: Couldn’t fetch from relays. Check your connection and try again.
web_sync_stale: The data on relays was updated on another device. Review the differences with “Load from relays” first.
web_sync_unknown_format: The data on relays contains a format this web version can’t read, so it wasn’t saved to avoid erasing it.
web_sync_unreachable: Couldn’t fetch the latest data from relays, so it wasn’t saved to avoid overwriting.
web_theme_publish_no_base: Couldn’t fetch the latest data, so nothing was published. Check your connection and try again
web_theme_publish_stale: It was updated on another device, so nothing was published. Try again
web_thread_unsupported_kind: Posts of kind %1$s can’t be shown on the web yet
web_tpl_status_hint: Now Playing and statuses from people you follow
web_wallet_desc: Connect a Lightning wallet with Nostr Wallet Connect (NIP-47) to complete zaps inside the app. Every payment asks for confirmation.
web_wallet_disconnect_text: Removes the saved connection info (including the secret) from this browser.
web_wallet_err_invalid_uri: Couldn’t read the connection string. Check that it starts with nostr+walletconnect://.
web_wallet_err_no_info: No response from the wallet. Check the relay and connection string.
web_wallet_err_unavailable: Couldn’t store the connection info on this device.
web_wallet_hint: You can issue a connection string in your wallet (Alby Hub, Coinos, etc.). The secret is encrypted and stored in this browser. It’s removed when you log out.
